TXT_SCREEN_SUBTITLE: Review generated DDL, configure PostgreSQL, and execute it in a sandbox environment.
TXT_SANDBOX_DESCRIPTION: The connection is saved per project and its password is never returned to the browser.
TXT_PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION: Leave blank when saving to keep the existing password; enter it again when testing the connection.
MSG_HOST_INVALID: Host must contain between 1 and 255 characters.
MSG_PORT_INVALID: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
MSG_DATABASE_NAME_INVALID: Database name must contain between 1 and 100 characters.
MSG_SCHEMA_NAME_INVALID: Schema must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.
MSG_UNSAVED_CONFIG: The configuration has changed. Save it before executing DDL.
TXT_RESET_SCHEMA: Drop and recreate the schema before execution
TXT_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_PROTECTED: The public schema is always preserved.
TXT_RESET_CONFIRM_TITLE: Drop and recreate the Sandbox schema?
TXT_RESET_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: All tables and data in schema {{schemaName}} will be deleted before the new DDL is executed.
MSG_SAVE_CONFIG_BEFORE_DEPLOY: Save a Sandbox configuration before executing DDL.
MSG_SAVE_CHANGES_BEFORE_DEPLOY: Save the configuration changes before executing DDL.
MSG_POSTGRESQL_ONLY: The Sandbox only executes PostgreSQL DDL. You can still download the selected dialect.
